title: Demo payment idempotency
text: Synthetic demo guidance: reuse the same idempotency key when retrying a payment request. Check the original status before starting a replacement payment. This KB does not authorize transactions.

title: Demo rate limit handling
text: For HTTP 429 responses, honor Retry-After and use bounded exponential backoff with jitter. Escalate persistent errors to the application owner.

title: Demo telemetry policy
text: Do not record card numbers, customer identifiers, secrets, or prompt text in telemetry. Export operational metrics and traces via OpenTelemetry to an approved collector.
